summary: Cresco Labs filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing shareholder voting results from its October 30, 2026 annual general and special meeting. Holders approved three special resolutions: creation of a new TopCo parent and exchange of Cresco securities and LLC membership interests for TopCo securities, a potential subsequent redomicile of TopCo from British Columbia to Delaware, and an extension of the multiple voting share listing sunset from the first to third anniversary of a US listing. Each matter drew at least 94% support; seven directors were elected. No deal terms, advisors or prices were disclosed; it is a routine meeting-result notice.
